texts.start: 👋 Hey {name}! This is the OpusMusicAPI Manager bot. Generate your API key, check your usage, renew or revoke it, all from here. 🎵 Fast, cached YouTube audio for your Telegram music bots. 👇 Tap a button below to continue.
texts.join_required: 🔒 Join required To generate your API key, please join our channel(s) first: {channels} Then tap ✅ I've Joined.
texts.join_error: ⚠️ I couldn't verify your channel membership right now. Please try again in a moment.
texts.join_still: You haven't joined all the channels yet!
texts.key_hidden: unavailable, revoke and generate a new key
texts.renew_nokey: You have no active key to renew.
texts.revoke_confirm: ⚠️ Revoke your API key? It will stop working immediately. You can generate a new one anytime.
texts.revoked: ⛔ Your API key has been revoked. Tap Generate New to create a fresh key.
texts.revoke_none: You have no active key to revoke.
texts.generic_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
texts.user_revoked_by_owner: ⛔ Your API key was revoked by the admin. You can generate a fresh key anytime, or contact support if you think this is a mistake.
texts.owner_broadcast_usage: 📣 Broadcast Reply to any message (text, image, video) with /broadcast, or send /broadcast your text.
texts.owner_broadcast_busy: ⏳ A broadcast is already running. Please wait for it to finish.
